question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks), list the port status, device owner, number of ports, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and the associated network status; also include, for that network status, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks with at least one security binding (excluding shared networks), and compute a derived metric of ports per security standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (port_count divided by the network-status PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)), ordered by this derived metric descending.

prediction.sql:
WITH port_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        p.STATUS AS port_status,
        p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner,
        COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count,
        MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update,
        n.STATUS AS network_status
    FROM `ports` AS p
    JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID
    JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.ID = p.NETWORK_ID
    WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports'
      AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (
          SELECT networkrbacs.object_id 
          FROM `networkrbacs` 
          WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' 
            AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
      )
    GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, n.STATUS
),
network_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        n.STATUS AS network_status,
        VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance,
        STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev
    FROM `networks` AS n
    JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID
    WHERE NOT n.ID IN (
        SELECT networkrbacs.object_id 
        FROM `networkrbacs` 
        WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' 
          AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
    )
    GROUP BY n.STATUS
    HAVING COUNT(nsb.NETWORK_ID) >= 1
)
SELECT 
    pg.port_status,
    pg.device_owner,
    pg.port_count,
    pg.earliest_standard_attr_update,
    pg.network_status,
    ns.port_security_enabled_variance,
    ns.port_security_enabled_stddev,
    pg.port_count / ns.port_security_enabled_stddev AS ports_per_security_stddev
FROM port_groups AS pg
JOIN network_stats AS ns ON ns.network_status = pg.network_status
ORDER BY ports_per_security_stddev DESC

  SELECT
    p.status AS port_status,
    p.device_owner AS device_owner,
    COUNT(*) AS port_count,
    MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_updated,
    n.status AS network_status
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = p.network_id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    AND n.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner, n.status
),
net_stats AS (
  SELECT
    n.status AS network_status,
    VARIANCE(ns.port_security_enabled) AS variance,
    STDDEV(ns.port_security_enabled) AS stddev
  FROM networks n
  JOIN networksecuritybindings ns ON ns.network_id = n.id
  WHERE n.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY n.status
)
SELECT
  pg.port_status,
  pg.device_owner,
  pg.port_count,
  pg.earliest_updated,
  pg.network_status,
  ns.variance,
  ns.stddev,
  pg.port_count / ns.stddev AS ports_per_stddev
FROM port_groups pg
LEFT JOIN net_stats ns ON ns.network_status = pg.network_status
ORDER BY ports_per_stddev DESC;
